title: ELANG v0.1.0 conformance expected-result record
description: One record per conformance fixture. Describes the input, the reader modes the expectation holds for, and the expected outcome.

description.description: One-line human description of the behaviour under test.

requirements.description: Normative requirement ids the fixture protects.

input.description: Path to the fixture input, relative to the directory that contains this record.

modes.description: Reader modes in which the stated outcome MUST hold. Inspect covers reader stages 1-7, Verify stages 1-11, Validate stages 1-12. For `outcome: pass`, acceptance is cumulative, so the record lists every mode down to the asserted level. For `outcome: fail`, the record lists only the modes whose stage ceiling reaches `stage`; a mode that stops before `stage` accepts the input.

outcome.description: `pass` — the input must be accepted. `fail` — the input must be rejected.

stage.description: Reader stage (1-12) at which rejection MUST occur. Required when outcome is `fail`.

errorCode.description: Registered error code from the OA-10 error-code registry. Required when outcome is `fail`.

golden.description: Byte-exact golden outputs, when the fixture pins them.

path.description: Path to the byte-exact golden output, relative to the directory that contains this record.
